About Retrokit

How we started, and how we source what we sell.

How we started

Retrokit began as a small matchday stall, reselling shirts to friends and classmates who wanted to wear their club without paying import prices. As word spread, that stall turned into an online shop — and by the 2026/27 season we were stocking a dozen clubs and shipping nationwide.

Working with the brands

Every shirt we list is sourced through authorized replica suppliers for the kit manufacturers themselves — Adidas, Nike, Puma and Mizuno among them — so what lands on your doorstep is cut, printed and badged the same way it is in an official club store.

Break-Even Analysis

How many shirts we need to sell each month to cover our costs.

Shirts sold per month

At an average selling price of ฿1,450 and a variable cost of ฿650 per shirt (stock, printing and packaging), each shirt sold contributes ฿800 toward fixed monthly costs of ฿48,000. Selling 60 shirts a month covers costs; every shirt beyond that is profit.

Frequently asked questions

How do the Special Limited Kits work?

These are pre-order only. Each kit is printed to order and takes 7 days before it ships. Special kits are currently only available in size L.

What sizes do you stock?

Season kits are available from S to XXL. Special Limited Kits are printed in size L only for now.

How long does shipping take?

Season kits ship within 48 hours. Special Limited Kits take 7 days to print before they ship. Delivery across Thailand is free on orders over ฿3,000.

Can I return or exchange a shirt?

Unprinted shirts can be exchanged for a different size within 7 days of delivery. Printed name-and-number shirts and Special Limited Kits are made to order and are final sale.

What payment methods do you accept?

Cards, PromptPay and bank transfer are all accepted at checkout.
